{{Quote|We all follow the Voice from the Darkness. As shall you.|[[Magnus Grenz]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CS" />}}
The '''Cult of Exar Kun''' was a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was devoted to the worship of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].

==History==
{{Quote|Professor Emanus has been leading an archeological dig on Yavin IV, as I said. They were hoping to find artifacts or relics related to Exar Kun near the Temple of Exar Kun. I fear they may have found something far worse|[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CS" />}}
[[File:TheExecutioner-GH.png|thumb|200px|left|The Executioner]]
The Cult of Exar Kun was formed in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when a [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]] expedition carried out an archaeological expedition to the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. They accidentally uncovered the catacombs beneath the temple, which reawakened the spirit of Exar Kun. The spirit enslaved them to it, making them into fanatical cultists that were devoted to its worship.

A number of the cultists, including [[The Executioner]], traveled to a [[Corellia University research outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and recruited some new members to their ranks from among the students and researchers there. One researcher resisted, because he claimed that people were being compelled by an unknown force to join the cult against their wills, so he was killed.

The cult based themselves around the catacombs beneath the Temple of Exar Kun, until it was wiped out by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], who were hired by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]] to destroy it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Cult of Exar Kun appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cult of Exar Kun was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
